scope: deterministic and seeded triclinic periodic-neighbor cell-list candidate sweep

candidate.change: enable the Cartesian replicated-image cell-list for non-orthorhombic lattices
candidate.result: periodic neighbor sets match the independent fractional-delta brute-force oracle across four hand-selected fixtures and twelve fixed-seed generated fixtures, covering all declared cutoffs

boundary: The final distance check uses fractional delta plus integer image arithmetic, matching the independent oracle at cutoff boundaries; allocation-cap overflow retains the reciprocal-vector fallback.
interpretation: The earlier candidate was rejected because Cartesian subtraction rounded a cutoff-boundary pair differently from the oracle. Recomputing fractional delta plus image before the final distance check repairs that mismatch. The hand-selected and fixed-seed sweeps broaden skew direction, lattice lengths, angle combinations, and fractional-site coverage, but this remains correctness evidence rather than a broad performance claim.
